svg.text: HDMI surface returns replace 20 Ground pad vias
Actual exported Ground copper after drilling · all component placements fixed
Removed pad barrels; all 416 Ground terminals retain drilled connectivity.
Candidate paths also survive the conservative 0.1 mm neck screen. Full geometry checked; display simplified to 2 µm.
Return-path timing, impedance, SI/PI and current capacity are unqualified. Mixed spans remain.
